name: Gromit Forger
headline: I build
systems
out of words.
intro: Gromit Forger is a visual experience designer who never says a word and lets the work speak. Identity, editorial, UX, motion, information design, and everything. A senior at SCAD.
statement: I believe a design should explain itself without a word of help. Clarity comes from structure, and character comes from craft. As a graphic design senior at SCAD with a minor in film and television, I work across identity, editorial, motion, information design, and type. Every project starts with a close look at the people it is for and ends with a system they can use without instructions.
